place.name: John Paul II Bridge (Gdańsk)
place.description: The John Paul II Bridge (Polish: Most Jana Pawła II), also known as the Third Millennium Bridge (Polish: Most Trzeciego Tysiąclecia), is a cable-stayed road bridge located in Gdańsk, Poland, opened on 9 November 2001 and linking the Northern Port of Gdańsk with the Tricity Ring Road (S7). It crosses the Dead Vistula.
